measurement_method: Replace with an independently measured board pose before calibration

coordinate_definition.transform_W_B: Maps OpenCV ChArUco board coordinates into SCARA controller world coordinates
coordinate_definition.board_origin: Top-left outer corner of the printed ChArUco chessboard, excluding paper margin
coordinate_definition.board_x_positive: Across the printed board from left to right when viewing its front
coordinate_definition.board_y_positive: Down the printed board when viewing its front
coordinate_definition.board_z_positive: board_x cross board_y; normally into a horizontal upward-facing board

notes: Do not change status to measured until the physical board pose and uncertainty have been checked.
A copied identity matrix is not a calibration and will be rejected by the workflow review.
